description: The pie chart, titled "Stimulus Type," displays the distribution of various types of stimuli used in developing story case studies of generative AI's use in journalism, with each category represented by a colored segment and labeled with its corresponding percentage. The largest segment, colored dark red, represents "Press Release" at 18.7%, followed closely by "External News Article" at 18.1%, which is depicted in dark green. The "Interview" category, shown in dark blue, accounts for 8.8%, while "Organizational Report" (light purple) makes up 7.7%, and "Event Posting" (dark red) accounts for 6.6%. "Organizational Website" (light purple) and "Intra-agency news article" (light blue) each represent 4.9% of the total. "Email" (light green) contributes 2.7%, and the smallest segment, "Social Media Post" (yellow), accounts for 1.1%. The chart visually emphasizes the relative proportions of these stimulus types, with the largest slices appearing to be slightly separated from the main ring, and the percentages are clearly labeled next to each corresponding category.
